mechanism_claims.claim_text: LysAB2 P3 damages A. baumannii cell envelopes in microscopy assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LysAB2 P3 against Acinetobacter baumannii ATCC 17978
mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology supports membrane/envelope damage but not a molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LysAB2 P3 increases bacterial cytoplasmic membrane permeability in FITC uptake microscopy.
mechanism_claims.limitations: FITC influx supports permeabilization; pore architecture is not directly resolved.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LysAB2 P3 caused statistically significant endotoxin release only at high concentration and did not show significant endotoxin neutralization at tested concentrations.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LysAB2 P3 in A. baumannii endotoxin release and E. coli LPS neutralization assays

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=8:Endotoxin release upon LysAB2 P3 peptide treatment
source_locator.method_locator: xml:sec=22:Determination of endotoxin-releasing and endotoxin-binding activity

mechanism_claims.limitations: This is an endotoxin-release/neutralization property, not evidence for direct LPS binding as the antibacterial mechanism.

mechanism_summary: Primary source supports membrane damage/permeabilization as the main direct mechanism for LysAB2 P3; endotoxin assay results are preserved as bounded context without overclaiming LPS neutralization.
